title: Explore recording rules on Grafana Play

blocks.content: Explore recording rules on Grafana Play to see how to find recording rules, how the two types differ, and which parts make up one recording rule. You don't change anything.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Identify recording rules on the **Alert rules** page with the **Type** filter
- Recognize the two types of recording rule, Grafana managed and data source managed, with the **Rule source** filter
- Identify the rule name, metric name, evaluation interval, queried data source, and target data source of one recording rule

## Before you begin

This path runs on Grafana Play, so it has no prerequisites. You don't change anything.

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

To learn how to create each type of recording rule, refer to [Create Grafana-managed recording rules](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/alerting-rules/create-recording-rules/create-grafana-managed-recording-rules/) and [Create data source-managed recording rules](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/alerting-rules/create-recording-rules/create-data-source-managed-recording-rules/).
